interface.defaultPrompt: Use Task Lifecycle to help me start a governed task in this project. Inspect the project read-only first; ask me to choose workflow depth and request permission before writing files.
interface.longDescription: Plan, review, and track Feature, Bugfix, and Docs tasks using explicit approvals, evidence-aware quality gates, and portable Markdown artifacts. No automatic source edits or external actions without authorization.

name: task-lifecycle
description: A user-invoked, Markdown-first lifecycle for governed Feature, Bugfix, and Docs work, with human approval, review evidence, and safe recovery.
